title: PTX资本Alvin Leo：AI原生公司，如何选对风险曲线？
speaker: Alvin Leo

segments.en: So as you can see, this new generation of AI native companies really can provide their concrete ROI to their sponsors, and we see incredible traction in the space.
segments.zh: 所以如你所见，这一代AI原生公司确实能为出资方提供具体的回报，我们看到这个领域有惊人的吸引力。

segments.en: And we think the key to investing in these AI native companies and picks and shovels company in general, is picking the right spot on the risk curve.
segments.zh: 我们认为，配置这些AI原生公司以及一般意义上的卖铲人公司，关键在于选对风险曲线上的位置。

segments.en: If you go into early, you are essentially underwriting scientific risks, and binary risks.
segments.zh: 如果进入太早，你本质上是在承销科学风险和二元风险。

segments.en: If you go into late, everyone knows about a company already, and the value has been captured. The key in our mind, PTX Capital, is to invest after validation and before consensus.
segments.zh: 如果进入太晚，所有人都已经知道这家公司，价值已被捕获。在PTX资本看来，关键是在验证之后、共识之前进行配置。
